// Gemini CLI 0.55.1, Apache-2.0: exact bundled ID stripping function.
function stripToolCallIdPrefixes(contents) {
  return contents.map((content) => ({
    ...content,
    parts: (content.parts || []).map((part) => {
      const newPart = { ...part };
      if (newPart.functionCall) {
        const fc = newPart.functionCall;
        const name3 = fc.name?.trim() || "generic_tool";
        if (fc.id && fc.id.startsWith(`${name3}__`)) {
          newPart.functionCall = {
            name: fc.name,
            args: fc.args,
            id: fc.id.substring(name3.length + 2)
          };
        }
      }
      if (newPart.functionResponse) {
        const fr = newPart.functionResponse;
        const name3 = fr.name?.trim() || "generic_tool";
        if (fr.id && fr.id.startsWith(`${name3}__`)) {
          newPart.functionResponse = {
            name: fr.name,
            response: fr.response,
            id: fr.id.substring(name3.length + 2)
          };
        }
      }
      return newPart;
    })
  }));
}

function send(contentsToUse, modelToUse) {
  const finalContents = stripToolCallIdPrefixes(contentsToUse);
  return finalContents;
}

// Exact retry predicate from GeminiChat.streamWithRetries, isolated for tests.
function shouldRetry(isContentError, isRetryable, signal, emittedOutput = false) {
  const isRetryableContentError = isContentError;
  if (isRetryableContentError || isRetryable && !signal.aborted) {
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

  const { newHistory, info: info2 } = await this.compressionService.compress(this.getChat(), prompt_id, force, model, this.config, this.hasFailedCompressionAttempt, abortSignal);
  return {newHistory, info:info2};
}
